title: AI Chip Shortage: Why Your Phone Costs More Now #shorts
description: AI data centers are booking hardware years in advance, driving up chip prices. Companies building phones face higher costs, passed to consumers. How long can this last? #ChipShortage #AI #TechIndustry #DataCenters #ConsumerCosts
